description: This file defines types, functions, and utilities related to execution approval requests and responses, including parsing, queue management, and filtering.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalRequested
methods.description: Parses a payload into an ExecApprovalRequest object if valid.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalResolved
methods.description: Parses a payload into an ExecApprovalResolved object if valid.

methods.name: parsePluginApprovalRequested
methods.description: Parses a payload into an ExecApprovalRequest of kind 'plugin' if valid.

methods.name: pruneExecApprovalQueue
methods.description: Filters out expired approval requests from the queue.

methods.name: addExecApproval
methods.description: Adds a new approval request to the queue after pruning expired entries.

methods.name: removeExecApproval
methods.description: Removes an approval request by ID from the queue after pruning expired entries.
